item.tib: mkha' 'gro dkar mo spyan gcig gi sgrub thabs dgos 'dod 'byung gnas
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro dkar mo spyan gcig gi bsgrub (sgrub) gzhung dgos 'dod 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ 'gro mgon mar ston rgyal legs kyi bsnyan (snyan) du brgyud nas rnal 'byor drag po seng ge'i dngos grub tu babs/ se dor tshul khrims kyis yi ger phab pa'o//
